title: StreamEvent
description: Events emitted by dispatch_stream(). The stream MUST emit exactly one 'done' event as the final event (or one 'error').

event_type.description: Discriminator for the event type. Concatenating all 'token' data values MUST produce the same string as non-streaming dispatch() output.

data.description: Event payload. Type depends on event_type: token=string, extraction=ExtractionProgress, continuation=ContinuationInfo, window_complete=WindowSummary, done=QualityReport, error=CRPError.
